nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set in the constructor and changed by acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
MVCMGToken.symbol: token ticker set to MVCMG in the constructor.
MVCMGToken.name: human readable token name set in the constructor.
MVCMGToken.decimals: token precision, 18.
MVCMGToken._totalSupply: total minted supply stored at deployment.
MVCMGToken.balances: mapping(address => uint) of token balances, written by transfer and transferFrom.
MVCMGToken.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of spend allowances.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): performs checked addition via require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): performs checked subtraction via require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): performs checked multiplication via require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function that stages the pending owner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner and finalises the ownership handover.
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender at deployment.
MVCMGToken constructor: sets metadata, total supply and pre-mints the full supply to a fixed address.
ERC20 totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using raw unchecked subtraction.
ERC20 balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
ERC20 transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender and credits `to` using SafeMath helpers.
ERC20 approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
ERC20 transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves balances and reduces the spender allowance.
ERC20 allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes the allowance then performs an external call to spender.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain ETH transfers.
onlyOwner transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): external call forwarding arbitrary tokens to owner.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks and allowance/balance bookkeeping.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed after the allowance state write (reentrancy vector).
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) whose boolean return value is forwarded unchecked.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(), not routed through SafeMath.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, guarded afterwards by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarded beforehand by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded afterwards by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded by require(b > 0).
Parameter a of safeAdd.
Parameter b of safeAdd.
Parameter a of safeSub.
Parameter b of safeSub.
Parameter a of safeMul.
Parameter b of safeMul.
Parameter a of safeDiv.
Parameter b of safeDiv, must be > 0.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, staged into newOwner.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Parameter to of transfer, the credited account.
Parameter tokens of transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokens of approve, the allowance granted.
Parameter from of transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall, also the address called back.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall, the allowance granted.
Parameter data of approveAndCall, forwarded verbatim to the callback.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token, the contract called externally.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token, the amount forwarded.
Return local c of safeAdd holding the sum.
Return local c of safeSub holding the difference.
Return local c of safeMul holding the product.
Return local c of safeDiv holding the quotient.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into owner during the Owned constructor, establishing the privileged account.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier which compares msg.sender with owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before swapping the owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] keyed by the caller.
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender], the caller controls which allowance is used.
approveAndCall writes the caller allowance and then hands control to the spender contract.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted to msg.sender == owner.
fallback is reachable by any msg.sender and unconditionally reverts.
Owned constructor assigns owner, initialising privileged state.
transferOwnership stages the privileged newOwner account.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner, changing privilege.
acceptOwnership clears the pending newOwner slot.
MVCMGToken constructor initialises _totalSupply.
MVCMGToken constructor credits the whole supply to the fixed deployment address.
totalSupply reads the stored _totalSupply value.
totalSupply performs an unguarded subtraction that can underflow if balances[address(0)] is non-zero.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the requested owner.
transfer writes both sides of the balances mapping.
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub for an underflow check.
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd for an overflow check.
approve writes the allowed mapping for the caller-spender pair.
transferFrom updates both balances entries.
transferFrom decrements the stored allowance of the spender.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
allowance reads the allowed mapping for the requested pair.
approveAndCall updates the allowed mapping before making the external callback call, breaking checks-effects-interactions.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract, allowing reentrant calls.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a caller-supplied token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the withdrawn tokens to the privileged owner address.
safeAdd executes the raw addition being guarded.
safeSub executes the raw subtraction being guarded.
safeMul executes the raw multiplication being guarded.
safeDiv executes the raw division being guarded.
Parameter a is consumed by safeAdd.
Parameter b is consumed by safeAdd.
Parameter a is consumed by safeSub.
Parameter b is consumed by safeSub.
Parameter a is consumed by safeMul.
Parameter b is consumed by safeMul.
Parameter a is consumed by safeDiv.
Parameter b is consumed by safeDiv and checked against zero.
_newOwner flows into the newOwner privileged state slot.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
to is used as the credited account in transfer.
tokens is the amount moved by transfer.
spender keys the allowance written by approve.
tokens is the allowance value written by approve.
from is the debited account in transferFrom.
to is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens is the amount moved and allowance consumed in transferFrom.
tokenOwner keys the lookup performed by allowance.
spender keys the lookup performed by allowance.
spender receives the allowance and is subsequently called back by approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance granted and callback amount in approveAndCall.
data is forwarded verbatim into the receiveApproval callback.
tokenAddress is the externally called contract in transferAnyERC20Token.
tokens is the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token.
Local c receives the possibly overflowing sum produced by safeAdd.
Local c receives the difference produced by safeSub.
Local c receives the product produced by safeMul.
Local c receives the quotient produced by safeDiv.
Operand a of safeAdd participates in the guarded addition.
Operand b of safeAdd participates in the guarded addition.
Operand a of safeSub participates in the guarded subtraction.
Operand b of safeSub participates in the guarded subtraction.
Operand a of safeMul participates in the guarded multiplication.
Operand b of safeMul participates in the guarded multiplication.
Operand a of safeDiv participates in the guarded division.
Operand b of safeDiv participates in the guarded division.

Parameter b only exists to feed the safeAdd function body.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeSub function body.
Parameter b only exists to feed the safeSub function body.
Parameter a only exists to feed the safeMul function body.

Parameter a only exists to feed the safeDiv function body.

_newOwner is only used to update the newOwner slot inside transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is only used to index balances inside balanceOf.
to is only used as the credit target inside transfer.
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transfer.
spender is only used to key the allowance inside approve.
tokens is only used as the allowance value inside approve.
from is only used as the debit source inside transferFrom.
to is only used as the credit target inside transferFrom.
tokens is only used as the moved amount inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only used to index the allowed mapping inside allowance.
spender is only used to index the allowed mapping inside allowance.
spender is the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens is only used as the allowance value inside approveAndCall.
data is forwarded unchanged into the external callback payload.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary contract invoked by the external call.
tokens is only used as the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token.

Return local c only holds the result of the subtraction guarded in safeSub.
Return local c only holds the result of the multiplication guarded in safeMul.
